Public fixture preparation, not a benchmark. GNU coreutils factor output is
untrusted until the Rust verifier checks divisibility, each prime factor and
every Pocklington condition. No time or calibrated operation count is claimed.

Choose a partial divisor F with F^2 > n at each node and base 2 as a candidate
witness. The verifier, not this preparation note, decides whether it is valid.
